text.description_html:
Deltana 55D2015, 22 Inch Shampoo Glass Shelf

This Modern Glass Shelf is comprised of a 4-3/4 inch x 22 inch frosted, white glass shelf with solid brass mounts which are available in your choice of contemporary finish colors. This 22 Inch Glass Shelf mounts to the wall and can hold anything from shampoo and other toiletries, to bathroom decor; and since it is made from durable, easy to clean materials, it will be sure to stand the test of time in even the steamiest of bathrooms.

Shop more of the Deltana 55D Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the 22 Inch Bathroom Shelf:

  • Material: solid brass wall mount with a glass shelf.
  • Glass Color: Frosted White
  • Mounting Center to Center Length: 17-1/4"
  • Shelf Width: 4-3/4"
  • Shelf Length: 22"
  • Glass Thickness: 1/4"
  • Projection: 5-1/2"
  • Mount Height: 1-1/4"
  • Mount Width: 1-7/8"
  • Concealed screw mounting.
  • Deltana 55D2015 22 Inch Glass Shelf Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 shelf, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
